_comment: Hand-curated dated instances of the LUNAR festivals in data/festivals.json, for the festival-dates page and the per-festival dates blocks. This file is the third voice beside festivals.json (the rule) and festival_dates.json (harvested announcements): a date the Thai lunar calendar has already published, checked by hand against at least one published calendar source, with that source on every row. Nothing in here is computed by us at build time — a row exists because a person looked the date up and wrote it down with its source. basis=lunar-published means the date comes straight from a published Thai lunar/holiday calendar; basis=derived means it is a fixed offset from a lunar-published row (the derivation is stated in note_en and the parent row is named in derived_from). When a year is not in this file, the site says the window and waits — a rule is not a date.
